governance.baseline: Schedules and target SLAs define the opening operating model; no visit or performance result is invented.
governance.finance: No invoices, charges or payments are created; BP-34 is the sole financial posting authority.
governance.people: No staff, contractors-as-persons, residents or other person records are created.
governance.units: The differing unit counts remain explicitly visible until identity-level reconciliation is completed.
governance.waste: Waste streams are service definitions, not fabricated tonnage or manifests.

unit_count_reconciliation.note: The development-control count is cross-checked against source unit identities; no missing occupancy or meter records are fabricated.
